answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit ember bond that vests over 10 epochs. At dawn, a pulse check requires a key-signed heartbeat reading; each dawn on time releases one tenth, and a missed dawn forfeits that slice. A farmer running 1,000 fakes must lock 70,000 credits, file 1,000 readings every dawn and wait ten epochs, while one honest agent locks 70 once and vests in full. A rented-ember ring fails: pulse readings are key-bound, unreplayable.
